verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents running many local LLMs (gpt-oss, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) through llama.cpp and Apple MLX backends, with Hugging Face search and download, and its headless service exposes embeddings. Community users corroborate that Hugging Face models download and run, and that MLX is supported, though one notes some HF models aren't listed without explanation. missing for 10: evidence of breadth across 'hundreds' of architectures, explicit MoE support documentation, any multi-modal/vision model support, and in-depth docs on embedding model usage.
